A '''Multi-Tasking Assistant''', or '''MTA''', was a compact device on which one could store information. It served as a sort of reminder mechanism or to-do list. One was used by the former reporter [[Den Dhur]] during his search for [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] parts for a new weapon for his friend, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]].
